neighbours.label: abstract noun for a held idea (idea, notion, impression, sense, belief), usually before 'that' or 'of'
fire: Critics reject the idea that art must be useful.
The film leaves the impression that nothing has changed.
Voters dislike the notion that taxes must rise.
Her speech reinforced the idea of a shared future.
The colour scheme adds to the sense of calm in the room.
Scholars question the belief that the manuscript is genuine.
He clung to the notion of a lost golden age.
The report creates the impression of steady progress.
quiet: Critics reject the film that won the prize.
The film leaves the theatre next week.
Voters dislike the tax that must rise.
Her speech reinforced the rules of a shared office.
The colour scheme adds to the cost of paint in the room.
Scholars question the date of the manuscript.
He clung to the rope of an old fishing boat.
The report covers the period of steady progress.

notes: ' idea' in 'no idea' did not fire in a probe (0.00), so the words alone over-claim; coverage here is an upper bound.
